text:
sahil: Quick heads-up  after enabling the new client route-shim in the TS/Go SDKs, the quota dashboard shows skew for a few tenants in canary. Not huge but noticeable.

gina: Can you share a repro curl? is this the `x-rd-route` structured header change?

sahil: yes. repro: `curl -H "Route-ID: acme-1" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'` clients rewrite to `x-rd-route` on the wire.

leo: grabbing logs  meter-proxy shows route_key=acme-1, ingest shows route_key=hash:ef12. Looks like ingest canonicalizer hashed the structured header.

sdk-bot: note: clients v2.3.0 shipped shim default-on for TS/Go.

gina: short-term fix: flip shim to opt-in in the SDKs and add an opt-in telemetry event so we can correlate hashed->original in ingest.

sahil: Agreed. Also propose a console reconciliation tile that merges hashed/unhashed during canary and exposes a toggle.

leo: I'll open an ingest ticket to either emit unhashed route or publish the mapping. If we publish mapping to S3 we can use that for console merge.

sdk-bot: @leo opened #INGEST-402 -> publish-route-mapping.

gina: I'll cut a patch to make the shim opt-in and add a small telemetry flag. Branch: `ts-go/shim-optin`.

sahil: Action items: 1) @gina patch SDK defaults 2) @leo publish mapping + short-term ingest change 3) @console add reconciliation tile + tenant annotation. Target: freeze default within 24h, reconciler in 48h.

console: acknowledged. will add dashboard panel showing dual-keys and a merge toggle in canary scope.

sahil: thanks. keep updates here and avoid tenant notices until we have reconciled numbers.
